THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper B · Domain 13 Research Methods, Statistics, Critical Review and Evidence-Based Practice

Aim and objectives

Aim. To prepare you to appraise case-control and cohort studies of causation and harm for MRCPsych Paper B.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Distinguish chance, bias and confounding, and name ways to control confounding, such as randomisation, matching and stratification.
  2. Calculate attributable risk and population attributable risk from given data.
  3. Explain why cross-sectional studies give prevalence but cannot show which came first.
  4. Calculate an odds ratio from a 2x2 table as ad/bc, and explain recall bias and nested case-control designs.
  5. Calculate relative risk from cohort data.
  6. Apply the Bradford Hill criteria, such as temporality, strength, consistency and dose-response, to judge causation.
  7. Answer the chapter's 37 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
